findings.quote: That extra cost buys judgment a robo-advisor's algorithm can't replicate: behavioral coaching during a downturn, tax-aware moves like asset location and loss harvesting timed to your specific situation
findings.defect: Inherited contradiction in the section that now says "For the full side-by-side with sources, see our robo-advisor vs financial advisor comparison". The SEC robo-adviser bulletin (capture 8afe23f0) says some robo-advisers use tax loss harvesting and some offer hybrid human access, and our own /guides/what-is-a-robo-advisor/ covers both. The linked page also gives subscription pricing rather than the "around 0.25 percent" figure. The inserted link sentence itself is accurate and the date is unchanged.
findings.fix: Either (a) narrow the quoted sentence ("Some robo-advisers offer tax loss harvesting and hybrid human access; ask each one") and bump the page date because this is a substantive body edit, or (b) remove the inserted link sentence and leave the page as it was. Do not leave the link next to the unsupported absolute.
